drafts.subject: PartScout RFQ: Custom mounting fixture (qty 1) — Protolabs Network
drafts.body:
Hello Protolabs Network team,

Could you please provide a quote for the following part?

Part: Custom mounting fixture
Purpose: Mount the arm and locate the workpiece
Quantity: 1

Key specifications:
• material: 6061 aluminium
• plate: 300 × 300 × 8 mm
• tolerance: ± 0.1 mm

Ship to: Sydney, Australia
Needed by: 9 November 2026

Please include unit and total pricing, currency, taxes, shipping cost, material/process recommendations, and estimated delivery time. Let me know which drawings or files you need before confirming the quote.

Thank you.
